evidence.note: The committed release record is a claim source; re-run pnpm check before approving a new tag.
Synthetic offline cases; the benchmark never contacts the public web.
Claims and CTA language must match the release status and current product.

signals.label: Successful reproducible quickstarts
signals.caveat: Do not infer adoption from stars, impressions, or a single unrepeatable setup.

signals.label: Categorized substantive feedback items
signals.caveat: Count distinct observations; do not count repeated impressions of the same note.

signals.label: Evidence-backed workflows approved for publication
signals.caveat: Never publish a participant story without written attribution approval.

steps.exitEvidence: Current release and evaluation commands are recorded.
One asset and one primary CTA are selected by a human.
Sanitized observations include a source window.
Each feedback item has one allowed category.
Repeated evidence maps to an issue, test, or deferred item.
The smallest relevant fixture or gate passes.
The next testable question is selected from the record.

nextTest.hypothesis: A checked-by-default public-web OSINT option makes the first-run result more useful without weakening consent or public-only boundaries.
nextTest.measure: At least three reproducible setup observations and the category of each onboarding objection.
nextTest.decisionRule: Keep the default when setup observations are reproducible and no trust objection remains unresolved; otherwise change the copy or default and add a fixture.

notes: Readiness artifact only: no campaign, customer study, or release publication is claimed.
Telemetry remains off by default; observations are recorded only when a human chooses to add sanitized notes.
